title: Chapter 201
text:
He had unlocked two new abilities and three new talents. Among them, [Bat Habit] was the talent for [Night Stalker] after all the abilities were maxed out.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao upgraded the new abilities to the highest level as well.

Field Control Vision Lv.10: + 15% Attack Speed, + 20% Range, + 22% Vision. Duration: 13 seconds. Cooldown: 12 minutes. Cost: 300 Stamina.

Lethal Critical Hit Lv.10: Critical Hit Damage increased from 200% to 250%. Four critical hits will be dealt to a target within two seconds. There is a 0.1% – 1.5% chance of causing a critical hit.

Fighting Mastery: + 5 STR, + 3 END, + 6% Melee Attack, + 4% Parry

Marksmanship Mastery: + 6 DEX, + 8% Firearm Attack, + 4% Attack Speed

Bat Habit: Vision is not affected by darkness. Able to sense the surroundings through sound. + 5% DEX when fighting at night.

He had spent a total of more than 12,000,000 experience to max out these abilities. Among them, [Precision Enhancement] and [Precision Repair] required the most experience. After all, they were the main class abilities of the second stage.

The experience on the interface was still massive.

With so many of his abilities maxed out, his strength had increased by another twenty percent.

This was especially so for the enhancement and repair abilities, which were the main abilities of the Mechanic class. The most noteworthy one was [Energy – Electromagnetic Enhancement Lv.1], which increased his Machinery Affinity by thirty-three percent after maxing out. Han Xiao could clearly feel that his understanding of machinery had deepened. The speed and quality of his machinery had both increased greatly.

Coincidentally, his Class Advancement requirement was to create five pieces of purple equipment with an Energy Rank above 60. His ability to create machinery had increased, which would help him complete the Class Advancement mission.

Five pieces of extremely good quality purple equipment with an Energy Rank above 60 — this was very difficult. The quality of the equipment in Galaxy was not difficult to understand at all. It was actually very similar to Sky Island and the Maiden. Low quality Epic equipment was not as good as high quality Purple equipment, and high quality weapons were much more valuable.

Han Xiao's abilities were maxed out, and he still had a huge amount of experience. As long as he chose a suitable blueprint and maxed it out, the quality of the finished product would increase significantly, and his success rate would be seven to eight times higher than before.

Han Xiao thought for a while and decided to fuse the blueprints first to expand his options.

With hundreds of millions of experience points, he could easily fuse the basic knowledge.

However, he did not simply combine them. He only combined the machines that he felt were reliable. After all, there were too many possibilities of combining fifteen pieces of knowledge. Every time he repeated them, it would double. If he did not control it, hundreds of millions of experience points would not be enough to fill this bottomless pit.

After merging dozens of times and consuming millions of EXP, Han Xiao obtained dozens of new blueprints. They were all in different branches and had different uses. After careful selection, he decided on three machines for his Class Change Mission.

[Compound Compounded Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades], [Iron Fist — Mounted Heavy Mechanical Arm (Detachable)], [Small Mobile Jet Propulsion System].

Not only did these three items fit the criteria, but they were also items that Han Xiao felt he could use.

Compound Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades was a weapon that was similar to the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor. The main body was a circular metal plate with a magnetic core, and the other parts were a few separate magnetized blades. By injecting electromagnetic energy into the core, the magnetic chain would be activated, and the weapon would change from a scattered state to an activated state. The blades would float around the core, and they would attract each other if they were more than a certain distance away from each other. If they were too close, they would repel each other, which created the possibility of mid-range attacks.

The operation of the Compound Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades was very complicated and unique. Energy was used to adjust the structure of the magnetic chain, changing the blades into different shapes. With different hand gestures, one could control the blades to perform all kinds of attacks and defenses. Just like the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor, it required practice.

Normally, the blades would be separated and could be stored in different pockets. Once they were used, they would be glued together, making it easier to carry and hide. It was suitable to be equipped with Viper. This was also a Super equipment that required energy, a Mechanical Pugilist equipment.

[Iron Fist — Mounted Heavy Mechanical Arm (Detachable)] was another type of mechanical arm. Different from the Light Mechanical Arm, the Heavy Mechanical Arm was huge, a few times larger than his arm. The power source was the internal motor and engine. Due to its huge size, it required a lot of Strength. Han Xiao had to equip Viper to reach the required Strength requirement.

Han Xiao was interested in the detachable feature of this equipment. When necessary, he could use it to equip Viper to form a more powerful form.

[Small Mobile Jet Propulsion System] was a device that looked like a belt. It could eject gas to allow the user to jump in the air. The fuel was very expensive. The belt had a tight fitting mechanism, so it would not be like an air jet backpack, where the user would still be in the same spot after the backpack was thrown out. The recoil would be a burden to the body, but Han Xiao was immune to it with his Endurance.

The biggest use of this device for him was that it would make him more agile. He would be able to turn in the air and complete all kinds of maneuvers. It was very mobile.

These three machines were the projects that he had chosen to make purple equipment. He felt that equipping the mechanical suit with melee weapons would complement the sniping style.

The blueprints for the other turrets, mines, guns, and bombs were not suitable for purple equipment, so they did not increase much.

Han Xiao directly increased the level of these three blueprints to the maximum level. He spent more than one million experience points, which was nothing to him.

"The materials on the plane are not enough." Han Xiao looked at his inventory. He did not replenish them in the Western Continent. He thought for a while and decided to use the maximum level of [Precision Enhancement Modification] to strengthen his existing equipment.

While he was busy on the aircraft bed, the plane flew at a uniform speed toward its destination, the Northern Continent.

…

One day later …

The plane landed on the coastline of the Northern Continent.

Han Xiao walked out of the plane. The cold air surrounded him, and goosebumps appeared on his skin. The Northern Continent was cold, and a breath of air was cold to the lungs.

Han Xiao rubbed his hands and exhaled a mouthful of hot air. He opened the map and muttered, "There are also four novice villages in the Northern Continent. I have to speed up. The most advanced players are about to advance."

Time was tight. After the pilot filled the tank, Han Xiao urged them to set off. They soon arrived at the first novice village in the Northern Continent and were warmly welcomed.

The players in the Northern Continent had been looking forward to his arrival. They saw the players in the Western Continent showing off on the forum every day. They were envious and looked forward to it. It was finally their turn to show off.

Of course, the players in the Southern Continent felt even worse.

Needless to say, Han Xiao stayed where he was. The players lined up to give him money and experience points. Their faces were full of joy, and the numbers on the interface kept rising.

Suddenly, there was a commotion in the crowd. Hao Tian stepped out, and the players around him spontaneously made a path for him.

"I'm here to buy a letter of recommendation," Hao Tian said.

Han Xiao looked up and had a thought. He recognized Hao Tian, a pro god who was on par with Li Ge.

Hao Tian paid the money and took the letter of recommendation. He was expressionless the whole time. He turned around and left after receiving the mission without hesitation.

At this time, the whispers of the players around entered Han Xiao's ears.

"Didn't Hao Tian complete all the missions in the novice village? I remember he left the day before yesterday."

"No, I saw him come back with my own eyes. He stayed for two more days."

"Probably to wait for Black Phantom's mission."

"It's a loss for a pro player to waste two days."

"To get Black Phantom's mission, if it were me, I would wait for ten days."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed as he thought to himself, Hao Tian seems like a good choice.
